say.title: When worry and sadness sit on your chest
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
say.translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa-l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa ḍalaʿi-d-dayn, wa ghalabati-r-rijāl.
say.trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

sadness.step: Say it once, out loud, even if your voice is flat. You are not required to feel better first.

know.title: When you cannot say it to anyone else
know.trans: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

story.title: What he said holding his dying son
story.story: Anas says he saw the child struggling for breath in front of him, and the Prophet's eyes overflowed. The sentence sets out exactly what is allowed and what is not. Tears are allowed. Grief is allowed. What is said out loud is the only thing being held.

say.title: When worry and sadness sit on your chest
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
say.translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa-l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa ḍalaʿi-d-dayn, wa ghalabati-r-rijāl.
say.trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

anxiety.step: Say it slowly enough to hear the words. If your mind wanders, start the line again.

know.title: When you are frightened of what might happen
know.trans: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allāh has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

story.title: What he told them to say when the warning frightened them
story.story: He said: how can I be at ease when the one with the horn has already put it to his lip, listening for the order to blow. It weighed on them visibly. So he gave them the sentence to carry the weight with.

say.title: When you are afraid of someone
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
say.translit: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
say.trans: O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

fear.step: Say it where you are, before you move. Fear does not have to be gone for the words to be true.

know.title: What was said by people told to be afraid
know.trans: So they returned with favor from Allāh and bounty, no harm having touched them. And they pursued the pleasure of Allāh, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

story.title: What to say after a bad dream
story.story: When one of you wakes in fright in the night, let him say it, and it will not harm him. Abdullah ibn Amr taught it to the children old enough to learn it, and for the ones too young he wrote it out and hung it on them.

say.title: When anger rises in you
say.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
say.translit: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina-sh-shayṭān.
say.trans: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan.

anger.step: Before anything else, stop talking. Say this instead, and deal with the matter later.

know.title: When anger has you on your feet
know.trans: If one of you becomes angry while standing, let him sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise let him lie down.

story.title: What he said watching a man's face go red
story.story: They turned to the man and said: do you not hear what the Prophet is saying? He said: I am not mad. He was too far into it to take the way out, and it was said in front of him anyway.

say.title: When you long for a family
say.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
say.translit: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-jʿalnā li-l-muttaqīna imāmā.
say.trans: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

loneliness.step: Say it aloud in an empty room. Then message one person, about anything.

know.title: Asking to be given someone to love
know.trans: O Allah, grant me a beloved who is dearer to me than my own self.

story.title: What Asim asked for when the arrows started
story.story: Two hundred archers followed their trail and found the date stones they had carried from Madinah, and said: these are the dates of Yathrib. Asim ibn Thabit knew how it would end. He did not ask to be saved. He asked that the news reach the one who had sent them.

say.title: When you feel trapped with no way out
say.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
say.translit: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina-ẓ-ẓālimīn.
say.trans: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Truly, I have been among the wrongdoers.

despair.step: Say the first line only, if that is all you can manage. That counts.

know.title: When you have almost given up
know.trans: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."

story.title: The bedouin who asked for something else
story.story: He came, believed, followed, and said he would emigrate. He was put in the care of some of the companions and he looked after their animals. After a battle his share was brought to him and he asked what it was. They said the Prophet had allotted it to him. He took it to him and said he had not followed for this. He pointed to his own throat and said he had followed so that he would be struck here with an arrow and enter the Garden. He was killed, and this was said over him.

say.title: When you feel you cannot carry it
say.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
say.translit: Lā yukallifu-llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā…
say.trans: Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

overwhelm.step: Put one thing down before you say this. Choose the thing, then say it.

know.title: The verse people reach for when it is too much
know.trans: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best [i.e., intending improvement] until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. And when you speak [i.e., testify], be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. And the covenant of Allāh fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember.

story.title: What he said to three men who had raised the bar
story.story: One said he would pray all night forever. One said he would fast every day and never break it. One said he would keep away from women and never marry. He said: but I fast and I break my fast, I pray and I sleep, and I marry women. Whoever turns away from my way is not from me.

say.title: When something good happens
say.arabic: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ
say.translit: La'in shakartum la-azīdannakum.
say.trans: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

gratitude.step: Say it before the feeling passes. Naming what happened is the point.

know.title: When things have finally gone right
know.trans: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

story.title: When you are given something and it still is not enough
story.story: Gold was raining down on him and he was gathering it into his garment. He was asked whether he had had enough. He said yes, and then said this: he still could not do without the blessing behind it.

say.title: When you feel someone's ill will
say.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
say.translit: Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi-l-falaq…
say.trans: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

envy.step: Say it, then make one quiet duʿā for the person you are thinking of.

know.title: When you cannot stop looking at what others have
know.trans: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

story.title: A one line instruction for envy
story.story: Wealth and appearance are the two named, which are the two people actually compare. The instruction is not to stop looking. It is to look in the other direction as well.

say.title: When you carry guilt
say.arabic: سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
say.translit: Allāhumma anta Rabbī, lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika ma-staṭaʿt. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū'u laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya wa abū'u laka bi-dhanbī, fa-ghfir lī, fa-innahu lā yaghfiru-dh-dhunūba illā ant.
say.trans: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

shame.step: Say it without adding a promise you are not sure you can keep.

know.title: When you know it was your own doing
know.trans: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

story.title: Two garments named as belonging to Him
story.story: A ridāʾ is worn over the shoulders and an izār is wrapped at the waist, and between them they are what a man wears. Arrogance is described not as a bad habit but as taking something off somebody else.

say.title: When distress presses on you
say.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
say.translit: Lā ilāha illā-llāhu-l-ʿAẓīmu-l-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illā-llāhu Rabbu-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, Rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm.
say.trans: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Magnificent Throne.

distress.step: Say it as it is, without arranging your words first.

know.title: Who answers when you are at the end of it
know.trans: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.

story.title: Holding Him to a promise He made
story.story: Abū Bakr took him by the hand and said: enough, you have appealed to your Lord persistently. He came out saying: the multitude will be defeated and they will turn their backs.

say.title: When your body hurts
say.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
say.translit: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.
say.trans: I seek refuge in Allah and in His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.

illness.step: Say it where you are resting. It is not instead of treatment.

know.title: Who does the healing
know.trans: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me. And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink. And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

story.title: What he told the bedouins who asked whether treatment was allowed
story.story: They came asking whether this or that was a sin. He told them Allah had lifted the difficulty, except from the man who takes something from his brother's honour. Then someone asked whether seeking medical treatment counted as a lack of trust. He answered with an instruction, not a permission.

say.title: When someone you love is ill
say.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
say.translit: As'alu-llāha-l-ʿAẓīma Rabba-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīmi an yashfiyak. (×7)
say.trans: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you.

someone-ill.step: Say it by their side if you can, quietly enough not to alarm them.

know.title: When you sit with someone who is ill
know.trans: No harm, it is a cleansing, if Allah wills.

say.title: When you have lost someone
say.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
say.translit: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn.
say.trans: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

death.step: Say it when the words will come. There is no window you have missed.

know.title: Praying over someone who has died
know.trans: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, keep him safe and pardon him.

story.title: The prayer Umm Salamah hated to say
story.story: Abu Salamah died and she asked what to say. He gave her these words. She said it. And she is the one who reported the ending herself: Allah gave me Muhammad after him. She could not have written that ending. She said the words before she could see it.

say.title: When debt is crushing you
say.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
say.translit: Allāhumma-kfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bi-faḍlika ʿamman siwāk.
say.trans: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and make me independent by Your grace of everyone besides You.

debt.step: Say it, then write down what you owe. Both are part of the same turning.

know.title: Refuge from owing, and from what leads there
know.trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

story.title: What he said when he repaid a loan
story.story: The lender reported it himself. Money came in, the Prophet handed the whole amount back, and then added the sentence, which sets out what a lender is actually owed. The sum, and being thanked for it.

say.title: At the end of the day, before sleep
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَىْءٌ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
say.translit: Allāhumma Rabba-s-samāwāti wa Rabba-l-arḍi wa Rabba-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm, Rabbanā wa Rabba kulli shay', fāliqa-l-ḥabbi wa-n-nawā, wa munzila-t-Tawrāti wa-l-Injīli wa-l-Furqān. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. Allāhumma anta-l-Awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shay', wa anta-l-Ākhiru fa-laysa baʿdaka shay', wa anta-ẓ-Ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shay', wa anta-l-Bāṭinu fa-laysa dūnaka shay'. Iqḍi ʿanna-d-dayna wa aghninā mina-l-faqr.
say.trans: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, our Lord and the Lord of everything, splitter of the grain and the date stone, revealer of the Torah and the Gospel and the Criterion. I seek refuge in You from the evil of every thing You hold by its forelock. O Allah, You are the First and there is nothing before You, and You are the Last and there is nothing after You, and You are the Manifest and there is nothing above You, and You are the Hidden and there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debt for us and free us from poverty.

poverty.step: Say it, then do the next practical thing you had been avoiding.

know.title: When provision is tight
know.trans: …Settle our debt for us, and free us from poverty.

story.title: What he asked to be kept among
story.story: Abu Saʿid al-Khudri opened with an instruction of his own before quoting it: love the poor. Then he gave the reason, which is that the Prophet asked to be counted as one of them at all three points, living, dying and standing up again.

say.title: When someone has wronged you
say.arabic: اتَّقِ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ حِجَابٌ
say.trans: Beware the supplication of the one who has been wronged, for there is no veil between it and Allah.

oppression.step: Say it. Being wronged does not oblige you to stay where you are.

know.title: When the one who wronged you walked away from it
know.trans: And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

story.title: When home is not safe
story.story: Āsiya lived inside the palace of the man the Qur'an uses as the picture of tyranny. She asked for the neighbour first and the house second: near You, and then the house. Allah holds her up as an example for every believer, man or woman.

say.title: When you are afraid of someone
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
say.translit: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
say.trans: O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

enemy.step: Say it without naming them out loud, if naming them makes it worse.

know.title: When people have banded together against you
know.trans: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

story.title: When you could ask for them to be punished
story.story: The angel of the mountains was sent to him and offered to crush the town between two hills. He said no, and asked instead that their children might one day believe.

say.title: When something you did not want happened
say.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
say.translit: Qadaru-llāhi wa mā shā'a faʿal.
say.trans: It is the decree of Allah, and He does what He wills.

failure.step: Say it before you explain it to anyone. The explanation can wait.

know.title: When you did not get what you wanted
know.trans: Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.

story.title: The first thing created, and what it was told
story.story: Ubadah ibn as-Samit said to his son: you will never taste the reality of faith until you know that what reached you could not have missed you, and what missed you could not have reached you. Then he gave the hadith as his evidence.

say.title: When you cannot decide
say.arabic: ُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِهِ. وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ
say.translit: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi-ʿilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratik, wa as'aluka min faḍlika-l-ʿaẓīm…
say.trans: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and Your power by Your might, and I ask You of Your immense grace… (prayed after two rakʿahs, naming your need)

marriage.step: Say it for them by name, privately, before you raise anything with them.

know.title: What a marriage is actually built on
know.trans: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

story.title: What to say over something newly yours
story.story: He said: when one of you comes to have a wife, or someone who serves him, or a riding animal, let him take hold of the forelock and say it. Jubila ʿalayh is what a nature was formed on, before anybody chose anything.

say.title: Said between husband and wife
say.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
say.translit: Bismillāh, Allāhumma jannibna-sh-shayṭāna wa jannibi-sh-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
say.trans: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You provide us.

intimacy.step: Said once, before, and quietly. Nothing else is asked of you, and it is not a test you can fail.

know.title: Asking for a righteous child
know.trans: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

story.title: Four words before, and what they cover
story.story: If a child is decreed for them from that, no devil will ever harm him. The second clause is a request made on behalf of a person who has not been conceived.

say.title: When you want to protect your children
say.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
say.translit: Uʿīdhukumā bi-kalimāti-llāhi-t-tāmmah, min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
say.trans: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every envious eye.

children.step: Say it over them while they sleep, or from the next room.

know.title: Asking for a righteous child
know.trans: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

story.title: When you are hoping for a child
story.story: Zakariyyā ﷺ was old and his wife could not bear children. He did not ask quietly out of doubt. He asked because he knew who he was asking. *So the angels called to him while he stood praying in the chamber: Allah gives you good tidings of Yaḥyā.* (3:39)

say.title: The verse for your parents
say.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
say.translit: …rabbi-rḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
say.trans: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

parents.step: Say it, then call them if you still can.

know.title: For your parents
know.trans: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

story.title: For someone you love who has turned away
story.story: He had been inviting her for years and she refused, and one day said something about the Prophet ﷺ that made him weep. He went and asked for a du'ā instead of arguing again. He walked home and found the door shut, and heard water, and she came out and said the shahādah.

say.title: When there is bad feeling between people
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلاَمِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
say.translit: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbinā, wa aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā, wa-hdinā subula-s-salām.
say.trans: O Allah, join our hearts, set right what is between us, and guide us to the paths of peace.

reconcile.step: Say it, then send the shorter message rather than the fuller one.

know.title: After a falling out with family
know.trans: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."

story.title: The limit on not speaking to someone
story.story: It gives the person who wants to fix it a way out that does not require an apology or a conversation. Say salām. Three times. After that it is not yours any more.

say.title: When you are studying or sitting an exam
say.arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
say.translit: Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā.
say.trans: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

knowledge.step: Say it before you open the book, not instead of opening it.

know.title: For anyone still studying
know.trans: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

story.title: The sign that Allah wants good for someone
story.story: Not knowledge. Fiqh, which is the understanding that lets a person work out what they have not been told. And the second clause separates the hand it comes through from the source it comes from.

say.title: When provision is tight
say.arabic: اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
say.translit: …iqḍi ʿanna-d-dayna wa aghninā mina-l-faqr.
say.trans: …Settle our debt for us, and free us from poverty.

work.step: Say it at the start, then do the work.

know.title: Straight after the prayer ends
know.trans: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

story.title: What Abu Dharr was still doing decades later
story.story: Someone suggested he take his servant's cloak and make a matching suit of it. He explained: he had once insulted a man about his mother, been told there was still ignorance in him, and had been dressing the man beside him identically ever since.

say.title: When you cannot decide
say.arabic: ُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِهِ. وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ
say.translit: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi-ʿilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratik, wa as'aluka min faḍlika-l-ʿaẓīm…
say.trans: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and Your power by Your might, and I ask You of Your immense grace… (prayed after two rakʿahs, naming your need)

decision.step: Say it, then leave the decision for one night before acting.

know.title: What to say when you cannot decide
know.trans: O Allah, I ask You to choose for me by Your knowledge, and I ask You to give me power by Your power, and I ask You from Your bounty. You are able and I am not. You know and I do not. You are the Knower of the unseen.

story.title: The boy who tested which one was true
story.story: A king's magician was training a boy, and on the road there was a monk the boy kept stopping to listen to. He could not tell which of them was right, so he designed a test with a stake in it: whichever way was true, let it clear the road. He threw, it died, the people went on. He told the monk, who said: today you are better than me.

say.title: When you set out on a journey
say.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
say.translit: Subḥāna-lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā la-munqalibūn.
say.trans: Glory be to the One who has made this subject to us, when we could never have done it ourselves. And to our Lord we are surely returning.

travel.step: Say it as you set out, not once you have arrived.

know.title: The call said on entering the pilgrimage
know.trans: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise and favour are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.

story.title: What he said after the traveller had already left
story.story: A man said he was about to travel and asked for advice. He was told to hold to taqwā and say allāhu akbar at every rise in the road. Then he turned to go, and once his back was turned the Prophet said this after him.

say.title: The one he called the chief way of asking
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ بِنِعْمَتِكَ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
say.translit: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā-staṭaʿt. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt. Abūʾu bi-niʿmatika wa abūʾu bi-dhanbī fa-ghfir lī, innahu lā yaghfiru-dh-dhunūba illā ant
say.trans: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am on Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour to me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me. None forgives sins but You.

forgiveness.step: Say it in your own words after, if you have words of your own.

know.title: When you know it was your own doing
know.trans: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

story.title: When you have done something you cannot undo
story.story: He struck once, to break up a fight, and the man died. He does not explain himself or argue that he did not mean it. He says he wronged his own soul and asks to be forgiven. *So He forgave him.* In the same verse.

say.title: When your faith feels unsteady
say.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
say.translit: Yā muqalliba-l-qulūb, thabbit qalbī ʿalā dīnik.
say.trans: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

weak-iman.step: Say it on a day you do not feel like it. Those are the days it is for.

know.title: When He feels far away
know.trans: And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

story.title: What happens to what came before
story.story: Then the reckoning starts from there, with the good counted ten to seven hundred times and the bad counted once, unless Allah passes over it.

say.title: A prayer someone asked for and could use
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَلِسَانِي وَقَلْبِي
say.translit: Allāhumma ʿāfinī min sharri samʿī wa baṣarī wa lisānī wa qalbī
say.trans: O Allah, keep me safe from the evil of my hearing, my sight, my tongue and my heart.

desire.step: Say it when the pull starts rather than after it has passed. If it has already passed, seeking forgiveness is its own door and nobody is counting how many times you have used it.

know.title: When the easy thing is the wrong thing
know.trans: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."

story.title: What he told those who could not yet afford it
story.story: It goes on: it lowers the gaze and guards the private parts. And whoever cannot, let him fast, for it is a shield for him. The second half is addressed to the ones the first half does not solve.

say.title: When intrusive thoughts attack your faith
say.arabic: ذَاكَ صَرِيحُ الإِيمَانِ
say.trans: That is clear faith.

waswas.step: Say it once and move. Repeating it to feel certain is the thing itself.

know.title: When the whispering will not stop
know.trans: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

story.title: What they heard him say in the middle of a prayer
story.story: Abu ad-Darda says he stood to pray and they heard him say it, then curse three times, and stretch out his hand as though taking hold of something. Afterwards they asked. He said the enemy of Allah had come with a torch of fire to throw in his face, and that had he not remembered a prayer of Sulayman he would have tied him to a pillar of the mosque for the children of Madinah to play with.

say.title: When you cannot see the end of it
say.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
say.translit: Fa-inna maʿa-l-ʿusri yusrā. Inna maʿa-l-ʿusri yusrā.
say.trans: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief]. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
say.audio_credit: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com

steadfastness.step: Say it, then do the smallest version of the thing you keep abandoning.

know.title: When patience is costing you something
know.trans: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

story.title: When you have almost given up
story.story: Yaʿqūb ﷺ had lost Yūsuf decades earlier, then lost Binyāmīn too, and had wept until his sight was gone. This is what he told his sons: go back and keep looking. Despair was the one thing he would not permit.

say.title: Standing at a grave
say.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، أَنْتُمْ لَنَا فَرَطٌ وَنَحْنُ لَكُمْ تَبَعٌ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ
say.translit: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla-d-diyāri mina-l-mu'minīna wa-l-muslimīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn.
say.trans: Peace be upon you, people of these dwellings, believers and Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, be joining you.

death-remembrance.step: Say it, then settle one thing you have been leaving unsettled.

know.title: When the thought of the Fire frightens you
know.trans: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

story.title: What his Lord promised him about his community
story.story: He began: by the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, no servant believes and then holds steady but that he is walked into the Garden. Then he said he hoped they would not enter before his listeners and the righteous among their children had taken their places in it.

say.title: When worry and sadness sit on your chest
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
say.translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa-l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa ḍalaʿi-d-dayn, wa ghalabati-r-rijāl.
say.trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

refuge.step: Say it before you need it, so it is there when you do.

know.title: When you want to be kept safe
know.trans: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

story.title: What he told Aisha while they were looking at the moon
story.story: They were looking at the moon. He pointed at it and identified it as the ghāsiq of Surah al-Falaq, the darkness when it gathers in. It is one of the few places where he named what a verse was pointing to.

say.title: The words he used over Hasan and Husayn
say.arabic: إِنَّ أَبَاكُمَا كَانَ يُعَوِّذُ بِهَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
say.translit: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimāti-Llāhi-t-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
say.trans: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every crawling thing, and from every eye that harms.

evil-eye.step: Say it, then leave it. Watching for signs is its own harm.

know.title: When you feel someone's ill will
know.trans: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

story.title: A one line instruction for envy
story.story: Wealth and appearance are the two named, which are the two people actually compare. The instruction is not to stop looking. It is to look in the other direction as well.

say.title: When you step out the door
say.arabic: إِذَا خَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
say.translit: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ʿala-llāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh.
say.trans: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

home.step: Say it as you come through the door, before you say anything else.

know.title: Coming in through your own front door
know.trans: Peace be upon you, people of the house, and the mercy of Allah.

story.title: What he said after gathering them under a cloak
story.story: The verse came down in Umm Salamah's house. He called Fatimah, Hasan and Husayn, wrapped them in a cloak, with Ali behind him, wrapped him too, and then prayed the words of the verse back over them.

say.title: What Abu Bakr asked to be given
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
say.translit: Allāhumma fāṭira-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, ʿālima-l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkah, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa sharri-sh-shayṭāni wa shirkih
say.trans: O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord of everything and its Owner. I testify there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself and from the evil of Satan and his idolatry.

morning-evening.step: Say it with the first cup of the day, so it has somewhere to live.

know.title: When you wake and the day begins
know.trans: We have entered the morning, and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah.

story.title: What he said at each end of the day
story.story: Four things are put under the same preposition. Morning, evening, living, dying. In the evening he left out the word for morning, because it had already happened.

say.title: Four words going to sleep, and what he said waking
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
say.translit: Allāhumma bismika amūtu wa aḥyā
say.trans: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.

sleep.step: Say it lying down, phone already face down.

know.title: When you lie down to sleep
know.trans: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

story.title: What he said with his hand under his cheek
story.story: Ibn Masʿūd describes the posture exactly. He would lie down, put his right hand under his cheek, and say this. Sleep is the small version of the thing being asked about. You lie down not certain you will be the one to get up.

say.title: Why he stopped a hand reaching for the middle
say.arabic: كُلُوا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مِنْ حَوَالَيْهَا وَاعْفُوا رَأْسَهَا فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ تَأْتِيهَا مِنْ فَوْقِهَا
say.translit: Kulū bismi-Llāhi min ḥawālayhā wa-ʿfū raʾsahā, fa-inna-l-barakata taʾtīhā min fawqihā
say.trans: Eat in the name of Allah from around it and leave its top alone, for the blessing comes down onto it from above.

eating.step: Say it before the first mouthful, not after you remember.

know.title: When you have eaten
know.trans: All praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from myself.

story.title: What he said as the food was taken away
story.story: Abu Umamah says this is what he said when the spread was lifted from in front of him. The two negatives at the end are the whole point. Not a parting word, and not a thing we could manage without.

say.title: Five things between two prostrations
say.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَارْفَعْنِي
say.translit: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-jburnī wa-rzuqnī wa-rfaʿnī
say.trans: My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, mend what is broken in me, provide for me, and raise me.

prayer.step: Say it in its place in the prayer, not as an extra.

know.title: The place you are nearest to Him
know.trans: The closest a servant is to his Lord is while he is prostrating, so say much supplication then.

story.title: What he said bowing on a night that would not end
story.story: ʿAwf ibn Mālik stood with him for the night. He read al-Baqarah, and every time he passed a verse about mercy he stopped and asked, and every time he passed a verse about punishment he stopped and sought refuge. Then he bowed for as long as he had stood, saying this.

say.title: What he said walking in, and what changed on the way out
say.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
say.translit: Rabbi-ghfir lī dhunūbī wa-ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik
say.trans: My Lord, forgive me my sins and open for me the doors of Your mercy.

mosque.step: Say it at the door, going in and coming out.

know.title: Stepping into the masjid
know.trans: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

story.title: Three men and a gap in the circle
story.story: Three arrived while he was teaching. One found a gap in the circle and sat in it. One sat at the back. One turned around and went away. The third is described in one line: he turned away, so Allah turned away from him.

say.title: When the rain would not stop
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ظُهُورَ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتَ الشَّجَرِ
say.translit: Allāhumma ẓuhūra-l-jibāli wa-l-ākām, wa buṭūna-l-awdiyah, wa manābita-sh-shajar
say.trans: O Allah, on the ridges of the mountains and the hills, in the beds of the valleys, and where the trees grow.

rain-weather.step: Say it while it is still falling.

know.title: When the wind picks up
know.trans: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it and the good it was sent with; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it and the evil it was sent with.

story.title: What he said when he asked for rain
story.story: Every noun in it is possessive and none of them are his. Your servants, Your animals, Your mercy, Your land. He is not asking for something to be given to him. He is asking for something to be given back to what it belongs to.

say.title: Two phrases, and a palm tree planted for you
say.arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
say.translit: Subḥāna-llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih, subḥāna-llāhi-l-ʿAẓīm.
say.trans: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.

dhikr.step: Say it while your hands are busy with something else.

know.title: The speech most beloved to Allah
know.trans: What Allah chose for His angels: glory to my Lord, and praise to Him.

story.title: What a bedouin was given when he asked for words
story.story: A bedouin came and said: teach me something to say. He was given this. Then he said: this is for my Lord, what is for me. And he was given: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me.

say.title: Five things at once, when you do not know where to start
say.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
say.translit: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-hdinī wa ʿāfinī wa-rzuqnī.
say.trans: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, keep me well, and provide for me.

misc.step: Say it once, and let that be enough for today.

know.title: What Anas answered when asked
know.trans: O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

story.title: Everything he asked to have covered
story.story: It works in pairs, and the pairs are opposites. Joking and serious. By accident and on purpose. Then the last clause stops pairing and just says: all of it, I have all of it.
